scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,processor,syncstart,realtime,frontend --prefix-colors blue,cyan,yellow,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:processor" "npm run dev:syncstart" "npm run dev:realtime" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:dependencies: docker compose up --detach --wait postgres redis migrations
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace=tournament_manager_backend -- --runInBand && npm run test --workspace=@tournament-manager/syncstart && npm run test --workspace=@tournament-manager/realtime
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
scripts.local:reset: docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && docker compose up --build --detach --wait
scripts.verify:local: npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && node scripts/verify-local.mjs
